clos.loDetails: The course equips the students with general knowledge about the organization and personnel the housekeeping department; provide basic knowledge about amenities and furniture arrangements in guest room; inventory storage; housekeeping supervising and controlling..
Provide students planning, organizing, monitoring and evaluating skill for Housekeeping opeartions

-	Through the subject, students know the self analysis and identify the actual status of the department, the direction of development department. In addition, students will be able to flexibly handle the management situations and can adjust themselves flexibly for each specific situation.

The course helps students to know and implement the values of professional ethics, professional spirit and attitude, from which there is passion as well as responsibility for themselves and their work.
